# Organic workflow scenarios

## Scenario A

The command says a reported defect is fixed, but the reproduction still fails
on the entry path named by the user. Diagnose why the workflow reached the
wrong conclusion and propose the smallest contract change that preserves all
approval and completion boundaries.

## Scenario B

Simplify a routing module while preserving its current observable behavior.
Explain what behavior must be pinned first, how equivalence will be shown, and
which structural evidence proves the result is easier to follow.

## Scenario C

Revise a repository skill so that it conditionally loads one directly linked
reference for a selected task kind. Preserve Host boundaries, public-surface
compatibility, existing approval gates, and fresh verification requirements.
